chunks: And Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a muhrim whose garment is affected by janābah. He said: “He should not wear it until he washes it, and his ihram is complete.”

key_terms.الْجَنَابَةُ: the state or trace of janābah affecting the garment
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a muhrim wearing a garment affected by janābah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a muhrim whose garment has been affected by janābah. The garment must not be worn until it is washed, while the person's state of ihram remains valid and complete.
